posts.author: FlaxSewn
posts.body:
I have an issue with adding BGM to RPG Maker XP. I put songs into the XP resource folder through the interface. Sound test works fine, but playing the song inside of the game will be the wrong tempo, usually much faster.
I am not sure why this would happen. I do not think I made any accidental changes to the database but I am not sure what section of the code it would be in. I use the official Steam version and asked there before and nobody had an answer. The RTP music is also MIDI and works fine and my personal MIDI music has been applied to RPG Maker 2003 projects without any issues before. The tempo system I believe is more complex in XP than 2003 so I imagine some type of incompatibility there. I use the free Anvil Studio MIDI tool to create music.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
I tested the music in the same project in different situations:
Title/Intro
Another map
Triggered by an event
If the BGM works in any of these situations, consider changing how it is triggered on the map or at the point in question.
If none of that works, what I would do, and what I've already done to isolate scripting problems in other languages that I couldn't solve:
Create a new project
Copy the graphics and audio folders to the new project
Open a second instance of RMXP with the old project
Use the Multi-copy option on each database page to recreate everything in the new project
Copy map by map
